objective: Add at least 24 distinct real photographs across at least six existing cars; no VIN research.
status: 30 verified additions across six existing cars; local validation passed; prepared for publication.
verification: Two GQ original San Marino photographs downloaded and visually inspected; event setting and open rear cover distinguish them from the existing delivery and studio images.
Image captions and owner attribution supported by the GQ article; original photographer Carson Chan credited.
Rame dealer photos compared visually with all seven existing gallery images. Three distinct views selected; head-on candidate excluded as potentially overlapping an existing crop.
Seattle friends article repeats existing group views; four migrated Shopify images return 404 and are excluded.
Blu Laguna candidate retained for further identity verification, not added solely on matching paint.

Top Gear gallery visually compared with existing Zandvoort images. Plate GJ 562 FL matches the existing demonstrator record. Fourteen distinct views selected; red-seat comparison car and near-overlapping tracking frame excluded. No identity classifications changed.

Del Vecchio public first-photo previews matched by GZ 926 LW and the source same-car index; new waterfront front and rear views compared with the existing February photograph. Restricted gallery images were not accessed.
Yellow development car matched by visible GJ 563 FL. New Ferrari/Car and Driver circuit images compared with the six existing Zandvoort images and later RM gallery; five distinct views selected.

Greenwich photos matched by No. 23 pale-blue livery, blue wheels, carbon exterior and blue cockpit at the same event as existing photos. Four new views by Charles; public file pages confirm CC BY 2.0.
Leclerc October 2026, May 2025 and other inspected first-photo previews already exist in the registry and are excluded from this batch.
Sven-Olof candidate was a configurator rendering, excluded; Gessle dealer rear photo duplicates the existing gallery.
Registry validator, EN/ZH coverage, VIN evidence, market evidence and frontend photo-rights checks passed; git diff --check passed.

Baseline audit confirms all prior photos preserved and all fields other than photos and source references unchanged. 30 new image URLs across six existing records; original-production coverage remains 38/599.
